title: ai-egress-approval.request
description: The Control Center-facing shape of an owner-approval decision on an AI egress policy decision (issue #217, ADR-0029). This request exists ONLY for the three decisions egress_policy.py already marks 'approval_required' - `decision_ref.reason_code` is a closed enum limited to those three codes, so a request naming any other reason_code is rejected at the schema layer. This validator (issue #172's fail-closed stdlib subset) validates each field independently and has no cross-field (if/then) keyword, so the schema alone cannot refuse an internally-inconsistent combination such as `classification: RESTRICTED` + `destination: cloud_sanitized` + a mismatched `reason_code`; the actual unconditional block on RESTRICTED ever resolving to cloud_sanitized is enforced by value, independent of `reason_code`, in `lib/omes/py/privacy/posture_projection.py`'s `authorize_approval()` (see its `_RESTRICTED_CLOUD` check and tests/py/privacy/test_posture_projection.py::TestRestrictedCloudNeverApprovable) - matching egress_policy.py's own unconditional `AI_EGRESS_DENY_RESTRICTED_CLOUD_SANITIZED` deny. `justification` is bounded to a short operator note and must never contain prompt/transcript/restricted-data content or a credential. This schema never carries a command, path, or anything executable.

actor.description: The owner/approver, not the original requester. AWCMS RBAC/ABAC must have already confirmed this actor holds the approval role BEFORE submitting this request - this field records who acted for audit, it does not itself grant permission.

decision_ref.description: Identifies the specific egress-decision-response being approved/denied. classification/destination are bounded to the two combinations that ever produce an approval_required reason_code (CONFIDENTIAL -> private_endpoint|cloud_sanitized, RESTRICTED -> private_endpoint only); reason_code is the structural backstop.

justification.description: A short operator note only - never a place for prompt/transcript/restricted-data content or a credential. Bounded length is a structural discouragement, not a content filter; policy and reviewer discipline (docs/control-center-contracts.md) remain the actual control.
